Shreya Sinha
Senior Digital Marketing Manager | Andheri East, Mumbai
shreya.sinha462@example.com | +91 9248795420

Senior digital marketing manager with a pragmatic, data-driven approach to acquisition and organic growth. Focused on integrating SEO and marketing automation to scale lead pipelines and reduce cost per acquisition. Strong cross-functional collaborator with experience managing Agile delivery and analytics-driven campaigns.

Experience
Zoho — Sep 2025 - Present
Senior Digital Marketing Manager (Remote)
- Led a cross-channel acquisition program that integrated HubSpot workflows and SEO-driven content, increasing MQLs by 48% and improving landing page conversion rate from 3.2% to 5.1% within six months using on-page SEO and targeted HubSpot nurture sequences.
- Reduced paid search CPA by 22% through coordinated SEO content clustering and refined Google Ads query mapping, reallocating 30% of budget to high-intent keywords.
- Introduced Agile planning with Jira for the content and paid media team, cutting campaign launch time by 35% and enabling biweekly iterative optimization.
- Hardened Linux-based reporting stack for daily performance exports and automated HubSpot audience syncs, improving data freshness and reducing manual reporting effort by 60%.

Kite Learning — Aug 2022 - Aug 2025
Performance Marketer (Hybrid)
- Architected integrated paid and organic funnels, combining Google Ads campaigns with HubSpot lead scoring to increase demo requests by 65% while lowering CPL by 28%.
- Implemented an SEO program focused on course-level keyword optimization and technical fixes that lifted organic sessions 72% year-over-year and increased first-page keyword count by 90.
- Managed sprint-based delivery in Jira with product and content teams, launching 45 targeted landing pages and A/B tests that improved form completion rate from 4.0% to 6.3%.
- Tuned bidding algorithms and Linux-hosted reporting pipelines to run nightly performance aggregations, shortening decision cycles and enabling weekly budget shifts.

Paystack India — Sep 2017 - Jul 2022
SEO Specialist (On-site)
- Owned end-to-end SEO strategy for India market, growing organic MQLs 5x over three years by executing keyword research, content briefs, and technical audits.
- Collaborated with paid media to align Google Ads intent signals with organic content, reducing overlap and increasing incremental organic conversions by 38%.
- Performed large-scale technical SEO fixes and server-side optimizations on Linux staging environments, improving crawl efficiency and reducing average page load time by 1.2s.
- Established reporting cadence and dashboards that tracked SEO KPIs and Google Ads overlap, enabling monthly executive reviews and data-driven roadmap prioritization.

Projects
- Content Cluster Automation: Built a HubSpot-integrated process to auto-generate content briefs from keyword clusters and Jira tickets, reducing brief turnaround time from 7 days to 48 hours.
- Linux ETL for Marketing Metrics: Developed lightweight Linux-hosted scripts to aggregate Google Ads and HubSpot data into daily CSVs for performance teams, cutting manual aggregation time by 80%.
